title: Beef fajita bowl with peppers and rice
steps: Cook the brown rice according to the packet.
Cut the beef into thin strips and mix with paprika, cumin, garlic, salt and half the lime juice.
Cut the peppers and onion into strips, stir-fry in the oil for 5 minutes over high heat and set aside.
Fry the beef in the hot pan for 2–3 minutes and return the vegetables.
Arrange the rice, beef and vegetables in bowls and serve with yoghurt, coriander and lime wedges.
